items.title: The Government’s $37 Billion Intel Round Trip Is a Warning for Anyone Who Still Holds the Stock
items.summary: The government's 433.3 million Intel shares were worth about $61 billion at the June 22 record close and about $24 billion on Friday. Here is what the same 60% drop did to a 66-year-old retired Intel engineer with 4,000 shares, and the sell, hold or swap math, including the two-year sale that cuts the tax bill from $8,516 to about $2,400.

items.title: AMD Stock Dropped 11% Last Week. Is Intel’s PC Warning Really That Bad?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAdvanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock declined approximately 11% from October 30 to November 6, closing near $449 as semiconductor valuations came under pressure. Intel (INTC) warned that PC weakness could extend into 2027, while AMD’s third-quarter data center revenue surged 97% to $8.

items.title: Intel Stock Has Gone Nowhere in 8 Years. Why This Time Could Be Different
items.summary: Intel just posted its strongest data center growth in 15 years, and the stock got cut in half anyway. Foundry losses, a cash-hungry 2027, and a few unnamed customers now decide whether the selloff was a mistake.
